name: Scamp
bio: Swings in, steals the high ground and throws things at you from it.
notes: From the owner's T-pose uploads (2026-11-01, "found some new ones"): an unrigged textured GLB, rigged here from T-pose landmarks (arms level; the manifest's landmarks, read off front and side views). Named here; the owner reviews it on the grip and portrait sheets. Not Big Bab (a macaque in a T-shirt, a CC0 community "T Pose Monkey" whose file name starts the same; this pattern takes only the 2026-11-01 download): a small dark monkey with a long curled tail (the tail is left on the hips).

source.author: Meshy community (author not recorded; CC0 per the owner)
